final_statement: Given an undirected graph, print the number of connected components (an isolated node is its own component). The input consists of a graph with n nodes and m edges, where the graph is undirected (directed = 0) and unweighted (weighted = 0). We must compute the number of connected components using standard graph traversal techniques. The challenge lies in handling large graphs efficiently—up to 100,000 nodes—and ensuring correctness without hardcoding examples or node-specific logic.
